title: Add WebSocket write deadlines to prevent slow-client blocking
definitionOfDone: Write deadline set before every ws.WriteMessage call
Slow clients are disconnected after timeout instead of blocking

implementationPlan.description: Add a constant `wsWriteTimeout = 5 * time.Second` near the top of gateway.go with other constants.

Before each `ws.WriteMessage` call (lines 2314 and 2375), add `ws.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(wsWriteTimeout))`. The error from WriteMessage already handles the timeout case (returns and disconnects the client):
```go
ws.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(wsWriteTimeout))
if err := ws.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg.data); err != nil {
    return
}
```
Run `go test ./core/controlplane/gateway/...` to verify no regressions.
